environment: Windows, isolated loopback node, Codex in-app browser
checks: Settings > Privacy & data exposes reviewed reading cleanup instead of the live legacy clear-history button
Initial review showed one local item, no opted-in sync entries, and one impending migration backup
Keyboard opened confirmation, cancelled without clearing, then confirmed; all four steps completed
A Windows handle without delete sharing held an explicitly named reading atomic orphan
Second cleanup committed source and replica, then reported unfinished backups/search; reading count refreshed from one to zero
Node was stopped and restarted with the same isolated home while the file handle remained open
A new bookmark using the same item identity was created after the source step
Pending steps survived restart; a changed backup was rejected until reviewed again
Reapproval of the current backup version remained unfinished while the file was held open
Fixed confirmation focus restoration and verified the persistent error retained keyboard focus after the dialog closed
Releasing the handle and continuing the existing job completed backups and search
My reading > Saved content still showed the new bookmark after cleanup
limitations: No packaged desktop, physical second device or cross-NAT validation
This flow does not erase saved documents, offline article files, browser copies or remote devices
Unseen concurrent remote reading edits remain subject to explicit conflict handling
